author: Eric Hess
releaseNotes: Faster frame handling (fewer database writes and cross-device calls), and saving the app no longer reconnects unless a connection setting changed. New: open and bypassed zone lists (per partition when you assign zones to partitions), a trouble summary and an optional UNO Status device; last alarm type and zone; arm with bypass; zone low-battery and lost-supervision attributes; stale sensor report; zone timer dump; keypad sounds (with diagnostic events); notification quiet hours, partition filter, repeat suppression and a connection-lost alert; a 30 second keepalive option (the heartbeat setting is now Keepalive) and a configurable command timeout. The event history is kept in memory and rebuilt from its attribute after a restart, and lastSystemMessage is removed (frame 09 is a keypad sound). A number too long to be valid in a zone, partition or PGM setting no longer breaks setup. Each part of a Contact ID event (raw string, code, qualifier, partition, zone, user) is now its own attribute for rules, and replayed (qualifier 6) events are shown as reports. A truncated frame no longer costs the frame after it, and the receive buffer is capped. A failed send now reconnects instead of leaving a command stuck, and a damaged Contact ID event or acknowledgement is dropped instead of being read as a different one. The partition device has a new armingMode attribute: the UNO's exit-delay state doesn't say stay or away, so it reports what was requested instead of the previous arm's mode. Update all drivers and the app together.
